title: How to reduce token usage in Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor
summary: Antoine van der Lee audits 1,674 agent sessions and identifies repeated context reads, duplicate skill loads, and unfiltered build output as major token costs. His measured Xcode-log example preserves warnings and test results while shrinking output; an iOS team can audit its own transcripts, scope instructions, and filter build logs before expanding agent usage.
takeaway: Measure context and build-log costs in your own sessions, scope instructions to the task, and filter Xcode output while preserving diagnostics and test outcomes.

media.alt: Author’s comparison of raw and filtered Xcode build output for clean and incremental builds
